title: Covid-19 in Pregnancy: a French Population-based Cohort of Women and Newborns
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to characterize the incidence and clinical features of the maternal COVID 19 infection, as well as the associated morbidity of the mother and the child, in the French context
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any woman with :

either proven COVID-19 infection= positive PCR test, OR probable COVID-19 infection = typical clinical symptoms AND typical pulmonary radiology

* during pregnancy or within 42 days postpartum,
* whether or not this diagnosis is followed by hospitalization,

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal to participate
* Major protected (curator, trusteeship)
study_population: All pregnant or recently pregnant women managed in one maternity unit of the 16 participating perinatal networks
